name: Quake

abilityDetails.Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Damage Reflect: Engellenen hasarın belirtilen kısmı, doğrudan hasar olarak rakibe geri gönderilir.

howToPlay: Quake için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Ricochet Pulse
Quake Blocks an additional [10 - 35]% Damage and Redirects it back to the opponent as a pulse of Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Quake generates powerful waves of vibrations that cause an Earthquake, dealing [306.19] Physical Damage per second.
Inflicts Concussion, reducing the opponent's Ability Accuracy by 100%.
While Quake is generating an Earthquake through this attack, the Aftershock Scale goes up by 1 every 0.48 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Aftershock
content: An Aftershock hits 10 seconds after an Earthquake. For every point in the Scale, Aftershock deals [863.61] Physical Damage.
10% chance to Stun the opponent for 1.5 seconds. This effect cannot interrupt Special Attacks.
Aftershock Stun Duration and Accuracy goes up by 10% for every point in the Aftershock Scale.
Inflicts Concussion, reducing the opponent's Ability Accuracy by 100% for 5 seconds when the Aftershock Scale is higher than 4 points.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Evades all Basic Attacks against opponents with a Concussion.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Adds 2 points to the Aftershock Scale.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Adds 3 points to the Aftershock Scale.
100% chance to inflict Concussion, reducing the opponent's Ability Accuracy by 100% for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Adds 6 points to the Aftershock Scale.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ricochet Pulse
content: Quake Blocks an additional [10 - 35]% Damage and Redirects it back to the opponent as a pulse of Physical Damage.
